title: Quarantine inherited publication, hooks and deployment

acceptanceResults.criterion: No token or service account from upstream configuration is assumed available or reused.
acceptanceResults.evidence: No .npmrc exists, so no credential for the @hyperframes scope. No remote is configured. No workflow references a secret because no workflow exists.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Push/tag events cannot publish packages or deploy infrastructure without a later approved release configuration.
acceptanceResults.evidence: All 18 upstream workflows were quarantined to docs/upstream/ at import; .github/workflows/ contains no file and none is tracked. With no workflow and no remote, no push or tag event runs anything.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Local installation does not trigger unreviewed repository or agent automation.
acceptanceResults.evidence: Root prepare hook removed; bun install completes with 1555 packages and no lifecycle script fires. Dependency-installed hooks are neutralised by redirecting core.hooksPath to a repo-owned .githooks/, verified by test.

findings.summary: Manifest-only auditing would have reported clean while git hooks were live.
findings.detail: The lefthook dependency installs pre-commit and commit-msg from its own postinstall, independent of the root prepare script. Observed firing on a real commit during AFM-003.
findings.consequence: The audit inspects the filesystem (.git/hooks) as well as manifests, and core.hooksPath redirection is asserted by test.

notPerformed: The 11 inherited publishConfig.access=public declarations were NOT rewritten. Contract C11 keeps the scope decision as its own tested ticket, and rewriting 11 manifests risks upstream packed-manifest checks. They are inert here: no remote, no workflow, no credential. Publishing @hyperframes/* from this repository is prohibited.
No destination-owned CI was created. Deferred with the rest of release scope; see docs/designs/scope-local-single-user.md.
